class.name: TwovoipOpusDecoder
class.brief_description: Decodes Opus packets into floating-point PCM samples.
class.description: Create one decoder for each Opus stream. Pass packets to it in order. Stereo samples alternate between the left and right channels.

method.name: decode_missing
method.description: Creates replacement audio for a missing packet. [param frame_size] is the number of samples per channel.

method.name: decode_packet
method.description: Decodes one packet. [param begin] skips a packet prefix. Leave [param frame_size] at zero for normal decoding. When using FEC, zero reuses the size of the last decoded frame.

method.name: get_channels
method.description: Returns the number of audio channels.

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns zero after success or the latest negative Opus error code.

method.name: get_last_frame_size
method.description: Returns the number of samples per channel from the last successful decode.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Starts the decoder. Use a sample rate of 8000, 12000, 16000, 24000, or 48000 Hz. Use one or two channels. You can try again if this call fails.

method.name: is_initialized
method.description: Returns whether the decoder is ready.

method.name: reset
method.description: Clears stored decoder state. Call this before using the decoder for a different stream.

members.member: Message for the latest Opus result.
Samples per channel from the last decoded frame.
